chapter.name: Chapter 1: Devil boy
chapter.content:
There are many times, Xie Chen thinks that he will have a comfortable and stable life-finish high school well, then finish university, if possible, get a graduate student or something, finally become CEO, marry Bai Fumei, and go At the pinnacle of life.

Until, met the hapless devil.

Sitting in the back of the classroom, Xie Chenbai held his chin in a daze.

"Young man, do you want to be a demon king?"

——At that time, I had just cleaned up a group of gangsters who came to fight with him in the town next door, and suddenly encountered the black light on the way home. That's the problem that guy opened his mouth.

"No." Xie Chen's answer was straightforward.

"Very well, since you want to be a devil, you have to... wait, why don't you want to be a devil?! It's so good to be a devil, delicious and spicy, and can make countless girls. One of the most popular professions of the century!"

Black Ray was very dissatisfied with Xie Chen's answer.

"I'm not interested in things with obvious weaknesses. Many legends have written that the devil will be killed by the sky with a fiery sword. I don't like being controlled by others." With that, Xie Chen wanted to bypass the black light, but Then, the black light said another word.

"If you are willing to be a demon king, I can guarantee that you will become the strongest. Although the path of growth is full of hardships and may even cost your life, I can swear to the contract that I will guide you no matter who your opponent is. Even if it is God, I will take you to cut it off the throne!"

Hearing this, Xie Chen stopped.

"Although I don't know who you are, I don't know how true or false your words are, but since you have said so, I am willing to give it a try." Then, Xie Chen turned around and held out his hand to the light. .

"But, if I feel...you are lying to me, then you have to bear the consequences of my anger... Demon King."

So, it became like this in the end.

"Oh! Xie Chen! It's really early for you to come today!" Xie Chen heard this voice just as he walked out of his thoughts. He instinctively hid forward and slapped a hand on the back of his chair. There was a bang.

"Fuck, it hurts, it hurts... You guy, your reaction is as sharp as you always did. I heard that you beat a few people from the next town to find faults the other day? You're really not afraid of big things!"

"They came to the door by themselves, is it possible that I have to hide?"

Turning his head, Xie Chen looked at the person who came—this is a young man with a sky-high hairstyle and a handsome sunny smile. He is also Xie Chen’s rare friend Chen Zhi. Although only 1.74 meters, he is the main player of the school basketball team. Like Xie Chen, he is a restless person. The fights in which the two participated are well-known throughout the school.

"Haha, what you said is right." With a big laugh, Chen Zhi tried to pat Xie Chen on the shoulder again. Unfortunately, after several attempts, he failed. He had no choice but to continue: "But, how about those guys? You are also a member of society. There is a limit to how you can play. If something really happens, don’t forget to call me. Together, we can definitely beat those grandchildren so that their mothers don’t even know."

auzw.com "Ha." With a grin, Xie Chen was still a little relieved after hearing this: "Thank you for your kindness, but if I guessed correctly, your homework yesterday Didn't you do it again, are you afraid that Allosaurus will abolish you?"

Allosaurus, the nickname of Xie Chen's class teacher, is based on the most ferocious dinosaur in the Jurassic-but also the most perceptive dinosaur. This nickname shows the terrible class teacher.

Hearing this name, the buddies suddenly showed a horrified expression, borrowed Xie Chen's homework and ran aside to "learn from".

After Chen Zhi was sent away, Xie Chen continued to squint his eyes out of the window.

The black light stayed in Xie Chen's body. He said that his name was Oraos, a great demon from another world. For some reason, he lost his body and had to survive in this form.

At the same time, Olaos told Xie Chen that he would fall into a short sleep and wake up again in three days. At that time, he could start to help Xie Chen become stronger.

"What will happen... It's really exciting." The corner of his mouth raised an arc, and Xie Chen looked at the back of his right hand.

There, a black magic circle existed quietly.

Suddenly, Xie Chen was slightly taken aback.

A strange feeling reminded him that it was a feeling that he had never had before, but Xie Chen knew that it was an alert reaction when someone was watching him.

Looking in the direction that the feeling came from, Xie Chen saw a girl who walked into the classroom in a school uniform. The girl had short black hair and a pair of glasses on her face, which could be said to be thrown in. A type that is unrecognizable in the crowd.

The only special thing is the girl's eyes without emotion.

"Good morning, classmate Shiyin." Xie Chen has not paid much attention to this young girl until she is secretly watching.

"..." Nodded blankly, the girl called Shiyin had no sense of being caught peeking, and went straight to her seat.

"Oh, Shiyin, I didn't expect that, Xie Chen, you guy, you are such an iceberg girl! I haven't seen you take the initiative to say hello to girls for a long time!" Chen Zhi, who finished copying his homework, did not know when After touching it back, I probably saw Xie Chen and Shiyin saying hello just now, this guy directly showed the wretched expression of the person who came over.

"What are you talking about, I'm just saying hello to her, isn't it weird?" Xie Chen said lightly, and began to prepare the class book. Wen Yan Chen Zhi shook his head.

"If ordinary people say this, I will believe it, but who you are, you have never spoken to a girl since you walked into the high school gate! How about, if you really like it, buddy will help you, but it’s not me. Shiyin is too cold, so no one dared to chase her. If you really like her, you must be prepared for a protracted battle."

"Come on, you." Xie Chen opened his textbook as he laughed away from his best friend.

At this moment, the door of the classroom was suddenly kicked open.

"Xie Chen, you kid, get out of us!!"..
